            Katie Taylor shares rare snaps of husband as they enjoy loved-up getaway

            The boxing legend is enjoying some downtime with her husband Sean following her victory in Croke Park in September - she shared some sweet photos of them both on social media

            News
            Erica Carter
            08:03, 12 Oct 2026
            Listen to audio version of this article
            Sponsored by
            0:00 / 2:31
            Instaread

            Katie Taylor has shared some rare loved up snaps with her husband Sean.

            The boxing legend is enjoying some downtime in the aftermath of her retirement and victory in Croke Park in September, as she jetted off to Rome.

            Katie and Sean were looking as loved up as ever as they saw the sights, with Katie posting a sweet post on social media.

            Sharing some photos of the pair exploring the city, the Bray native wrote: "A beautiful city with my favourite person!"

            The comments were filled with kind messages, as one follower wrote: "Love this. Amazing city."

            "So glad you found love Katie enjoy Rome," another gushed.

            A third wrote: "You look so happy and content, its so lovely to see this chapter of your life having been following you for so long through your journey. Enjoy every bit of this."

            In the snaps, Katie and Sean can be seen in a selfie on the streets of Rome, while in another he gives her a kiss as they pose in front of the iconic Colosseum.

            Katie married husband Sean McCavanagh last year in a private wedding.

            Sean, from America, is the father to two sons and three daughters, who range in age from 11 to 23, after his wife passed away in October 2023.

            The pair keep their relationship mostly under wraps, but Katie has spoken about the "blessing" of becoming a stepmum.

            "He's the father of five amazing kids and it's definitely been a blessing for sure," the sports star told Brendan O'Connor on RTE Radio 1 earlier this year.

            "They are five great kids, also with great senses of humour."

            She continued: "There has definitely been lots of adjustments and lots of challenges along the way, but I'm not sure it's changed me a lot."

            "I'm definitely enjoying it and learning from it.

            "It's a great privilege to be a stepmother and I'm very privileged to be a wife to an amazing man.

            Article continues below

            "I want to honour my husband, and I want to be the best stepmother I can be as well."
